pass_scope: A pass means only that the required commit status for the current commit is success; it does not attest triple-review completion or pull-request merge readiness.

status_precedence.when: one or more current-head or proven-ancestor findings remain applicable
status_precedence.mixed_input_summary: Report the confirmed finding and also name any concurrent deterministic or exhausted transient evidence error.

status_precedence.when: no applicable finding remains and deterministic invalid evidence or an exhausted transient acquisition/reconciliation error is present
status_precedence.mixed_input_summary: Do not hide the evidence error behind an older clean artifact or an unknown ancestry claim.

status_precedence.when: a carrier-valid selected clean artifact binds strongly to the current head, no applicable finding or evidence error remains, and the final PR/head/complete-evidence reread is stable
status_precedence.mixed_input_summary: Success is forbidden until final stability and the absence of applicable unresolved findings are re-established.

status_precedence.when: the remaining current-scope evidence is valid progress, a bounded recoverable acquisition/reconciliation wait, or no acceptable terminal artifact
status_precedence.mixed_input_summary: Pending follows the existing marker and deadline orchestration and does not itself authorize a replacement review request.

commit_binding.issue_comment_clean: Exactly one syntactically valid Reviewed commit marker is required and must resolve uniquely to the current full commit SHA.
commit_binding.pull_request_review_clean: The native REST full commit_id is authoritative; every reviewed-commit hash present in the body must agree with it.
commit_binding.finding: The provider identity and exact repository/full-commit binding must be validated before a commit relation can be classified.
commit_binding.request_watermark: A request watermark is orchestration history only and never substitutes for artifact commit binding.

finding_closure.joined_thread: Only authoritative isResolved === true for the exact joined thread closes the finding; isOutdated and later clean artifacts have no closing authority.
finding_closure.threadless: An older same-head or proven-ancestor threadless finding is superseded only by the selected carrier-valid current-head clean artifact when it is strictly later.
finding_closure.strictly_later: Issue comments order by validated updated_at revision time; equal revision seconds are always ambiguous and issue-comment IDs never break that tie because created_at equal to updated_at cannot prove that no same-second edit occurred. Pull-request reviews order by validated submitted_at, where a larger canonical numeric ID breaks an equal-time tie only within that review channel. Equal-time cross-channel pairs are ambiguous evidence errors.
finding_closure.nonancestor: Non-ancestor removal is scope exclusion, never finding closure.
finding_closure.unknown: Unknown ancestry never authorises supersession or non-ancestor exclusion.

orchestration.eyes_effect: Move waiting_ack to waiting_result without resetting or extending result deadline.
orchestration.plus_one_effect: No pass, acknowledgement, timeout reset, or deadline extension.
orchestration.progress_effect: Keep pending under the existing marker/deadline; do not acknowledge, reset, extend, or immediately repost a review request.
orchestration.malformed_effect: Write deterministic error without automatically posting a review request.
orchestration.transient_effect: Retry only bounded acquisition/reconciliation; never blind-POST a review request.

producer_receipt_boundary.selector_authority: The permanent v1 caller selector is not authority by itself; consumers must resolve and validate the exact called-workflow commit from the producer receipt and exact run-attempt referenced_workflows evidence.
producer_receipt_boundary.availability: GitHub.com only; GitHub Enterprise Server runs do not emit producer receipt artifacts.
producer_receipt_boundary.status_context_selection: Select the newest logical context case-insensitively, then require exact context spelling on the selected status.
producer_receipt_boundary.status_post_response: Retain the exact REST id and node_id plus echoed context/state/description/target_url and creator identity.
producer_receipt_boundary.status_graphql_reread: POST https://api.github.com/graphql node(id: $node_id) as StatusContext and compare id, context, state, description, targetUrl, createdAt, creator, and commit.oid.
producer_receipt_boundary.deduplication: Receipt mode always reasserts the current attempt status. Outside receipt mode, deduplicate only an exact current-attempt target_url, exact context spelling, exact state, and github-actions[bot]/Bot producer.

referenced_workflows.rerun_resolution: Validate referenced_workflows from the exact receipt run attempt; never substitute the current v1 target or evidence from another attempt.
referenced_workflows.tag_drift: A later v1 move does not change the exact called-workflow SHA recorded for an earlier run attempt.

called_workflow_authority.caller_called_sha_domain_separation: GITHUB_WORKFLOW_SHA identifies the caller workflow file and must not be required to equal producer.job.workflow_sha for a reusable invocation.

producer_receipt_boundary.provenance_strength: A validated run-bound artifact is causal producer evidence, not a signature, OIDC attestation, cryptographic provenance proof, or content-addressed storage guarantee.
producer_receipt_boundary.consumer_requirement: Consumers must validate the exact run-attempt API response and its exactly selected referenced-workflow member, resolved called-workflow release provenance, run-level artifact inventory, attempt-specific artifact name, artifact metadata/run association/id/url/digest and receipt bytes, REST status membership, GraphQL StatusContext membership, exact workflow/action bindings, and independently re-reduce provider evidence.
